items.title: Jayden Daniels: No limitations expected in return
items.text:
Offensive coordinator David Blough said Thursday that Daniels (left elbow) is "full go" for Sunday's game against the Giants and won't have any limitations, John Keim of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Caleb Williams: Showing signs of progress
items.text:
Williams (hamstring) has made tangible progress in his recovery from a Grade 2 hamstring strain sustained in the Week 2 loss to the Vikings, Dan Wiederer of The Athletic reports.
